system.description:
Favoured weapon: Mace, Large

Granted power: Advantage on checks to recall or find historical information. Once/day: perfectly recall any event you witnessed. Against a creature you fought in an earlier encounter, one spell of yours each round ignores its resistances.

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Annam in the World of Arneyan wiki.
